_doc: The anomaly rule registry (Peringatan Keamanan, Pro). One entry per rule; ids are stable and never renamed. status: live | beta | planned — only live rules run, show in the app and reach the landing page (tool/product_catalog/sync.py in the FE repo reads this file). Copy is Indonesian + English; {tokens} are filled per event. See docs/modules/ANOMALY.md (FE repo).

summary.id: Satu orang membatalkan, meretur atau me-refund terlalu banyak transaksi dalam sehari.
summary.en: One person voids, returns or refunds too many sales in a day.

body.en: Total {amount} · your limit is {maxPerDay} a day · {outlet}

rules.engineering: voidSales/returnSales/refundSales, after the transaction commits. Count = sales with REVERSED_BY_USER_ID = actor and REVERSED_AT since WIB midnight. Push when the count first passes the limit and once more at twice that count. Dedupe per (rule, user, WIB day).

summary.id: Penjualan tunai dibatalkan oleh kasir yang sama tak lama setelah dibayar.
summary.en: A cash sale is reversed by the same cashier soon after it was paid.

title.id: {user} membatalkan penjualan tunai {minutes} menit setelah dibayar
title.en: {user} reversed a cash sale {minutes} min after payment

rules.engineering: voidSales/returnSales/refundSales, after commit. Cash = any payment with method 'Cash'. Same user = Sales.PERFORMED_BY_USER_ID equals the reverser (sales rung before the column existed are skipped). Minutes since the latest payment's CREATED_AT. Dedupe per sale.

summary.id: Diskon manual pada satu penjualan melebihi persentase yang Anda tetapkan.
summary.en: A manual discount on one sale is above the percentage you set.

title.en: {user} gave a {percent}% discount on one sale

rules.engineering: completeNewSales, after commit. Manual discount only (line discounts + order discount, never loyalty/voucher/package) as a share of Σ price × qty (manual-discount.ts summary). Also fires when an offline sale over the cashier cap was accepted late. Dedupe per sale.

summary.id: Ada barang yang terjual lebih murah dari harga modalnya.
summary.en: An item was sold for less than it cost you.

rules.engineering: completeNewSales, after commit. Per item (FIFO split lines summed): line price − line discount − its share of the order discount < line cost. Lines with cost 0 are skipped (no cost on record). Dedupe per sale.

summary.id: Stok dikurangi lewat penyesuaian dengan nilai modal di atas batas Anda.
summary.en: Stock is written off through an adjustment worth more than your limit.

rules.engineering: stockAdjustment, after commit, from the FIFO cost of the negative adjustQuantity lines (wastageEntries). Recount overrides are not write-offs. One event per adjustment request and outlet.

summary.id: Uang tunai yang dihitung saat tutup sesi kurang dari yang seharusnya.
summary.en: The cash counted at session close is less than it should be.

rules.engineering: POST /session/createDeclarations, after it saves, for a Cash declaration. Expected = session opening float + Σ cash payments in the session (not voided/returned/refunded) − Σ cash expenses of the session — computed by the server, never the phone's figure. Dedupe per session. BETA: the app only sends a cash count when cash reconciliation is on (FeatureFlags.expensesEnabled) — flip to live with it.

summary.id: Penjualan atau penyesuaian stok di luar jam buka yang Anda tetapkan.
summary.en: A sale or stock adjustment outside the opening hours you set.

rules.engineering: completeNewSales (clientCreatedAt, else the server's time) and stockAdjustment (server time), after commit; hours in WIB, a window may wrap midnight. Off until the owner sets the hours and switches it on. One event per user per WIB day; later actions add to it without another push.

summary.id: Harga beli dari pemasok naik dibanding harga biasanya.
summary.en: A supplier charges more than their usual price for an item.

body.id: Naik sampai {percent}% · tambahan {amount} di surat jalan {document} · {outlet}
body.en: Up to {percent}% more · {amount} extra on delivery {document} · {outlet}

rules.engineering: Delivery order create/update, after commit, for received lines with a supplier. Baseline = ItemSupplier.cost (the agreed price), else that supplier's previous received unit price for the item/variant. A line counts when it is above the baseline by minPercent AND minRupiah per unit; WARNING when the rise is twice minPercent. Dedupe per delivery order.

summary.id: Dalam 7 hari, satu kasir membatalkan jauh lebih sering dari kasir lain di outlet yang sama.
summary.en: Over 7 days, one cashier reverses far more often than the others at the same outlet.

title.en: {user} reversed the most sales this week

rules.engineering: Nightly (the closing-report hour), per outlet, last 7 WIB days: per cashier, reversals (REVERSED_BY_USER_ID) ÷ sales rung (PERFORMED_BY_USER_ID) vs the other cashiers together (they need ≥ 10 sales). Fires when the cashier has ≥ minReversals and a rate ≥ multiple × the others'. Dedupe per user, outlet and week.

summary.id: Kas satu orang kurang beberapa kali dalam seminggu, walau tiap kali sedikit.
summary.en: One person's cash comes up short several times in a week, even if only a little each time.

title.en: {user}'s cash was short {count} times in 7 days

rules.engineering: Nightly (the closing-report hour): cash declarations of the last 7 WIB days, each against the server-computed expected cash, grouped by who closed the session; any shortage counts. Dedupe per user and week. BETA with CASH_SHORTAGE (needs the app's cash count).

summary.id: Setiap malam: penjualan, laba, dan peringatan hari ini — atau "Hari ini aman".
summary.en: Every night: today's sales, profit and alerts — or "All quiet today".

rules.engineering: Not a rule: src/cron/anomaly-daily.cron.ts, every hour 17:05–23:05 WIB, sends to tenants whose hour matches (Pro, live databases only). Today's (WIB) sales across outlets: count, total, gross profit; today's alerts and how many are still open. Skipped on a day with no sales and no alerts. Push type daily_report on tenant_{id}_security, one per tenant per day.
